taiwan.fact: The long-tailed Taiwan blue magpie lives only in Taiwan.
taiwan.ask: Which island is the only home of a long-tailed blue magpie with a red bill?

taiwan.fact: In 2001 people in Taiwan voted the Formosan black bear the animal that best represents the island.
taiwan.ask: Where did people vote in 2001 for a black bear with a white V on its chest as their most representative wild animal?

thailand.fact: The Siamese fighting fish, or betta, is the national aquatic animal of Thailand.
thailand.ask: Which country's national aquatic animal is the betta, a colorful fighting fish?

vietnam.fact: The saola, a rare forest animal nicknamed the Asian unicorn, was discovered by scientists in 1992 in Vu Quang National Park in Vietnam.
vietnam.ask: In which country's Vu Quang National Park was the saola, the Asian unicorn, discovered in 1992?

vietnam.fact: The Tonkin snub-nosed monkey, with a pink nose and blue patches around its eyes, lives only in northern Vietnam.
vietnam.ask: Which country is the only home of the Tonkin snub-nosed monkey?

australia.fact: The platypus, a duck-billed mammal that lays eggs, lives only in eastern Australia.
australia.ask: Which country is the only home of the platypus, an egg-laying mammal with a duck-like bill?

new-zealand.fact: The kākāpō of New Zealand is the world's only flightless parrot and also the heaviest parrot.
new-zealand.ask: Which country is home to the kākāpō, the world's only flightless parrot?

new-zealand.fact: The tuatara looks like a lizard but is the last survivor of an ancient group of reptiles, and it lives only in New Zealand.
new-zealand.ask: Which country is the only home of the tuatara, a reptile from an ancient family?

papua-new-guinea.fact: Queen Alexandra's birdwing, the largest butterfly in the world, lives only in the forests of Oro Province in Papua New Guinea.
papua-new-guinea.ask: Which country's Oro Province is the only home of the world's largest butterfly?

papua-new-guinea.fact: The hooded pitohui of New Guinea is one of the few poisonous birds, with toxins in its skin and feathers.
papua-new-guinea.ask: Which Pacific country is home to the hooded pitohui, one of the few poisonous birds?

fiji.fact: The Fiji crested iguana, a green lizard with white stripes, lives only on a few dry islands of Fiji, such as Yadua Taba.
fiji.ask: Which island country is the only home of the crested iguana of Yadua Taba?

solomon-islands.fact: The Arnavon Islands in the Solomon Islands are the largest nesting place for hawksbill turtles in the oceanic South Pacific.
solomon-islands.ask: Which country's Arnavon Islands are the biggest hawksbill turtle nesting place in the South Pacific islands?

vanuatu.fact: The Vanuatu megapode, a chicken-like bird that buries its eggs instead of sitting on them, is found only in Vanuatu.
vanuatu.ask: Which island country is the only home of a megapode called the New Hebrides scrubfowl?

samoa.fact: The tooth-billed pigeon, or manumea, is Samoa's national bird and lives nowhere else.
samoa.ask: Which island country's national bird is the manumea, a tooth-billed pigeon found nowhere else?

tonga.fact: The malau, a megapode bird of Tonga, buries its eggs in warm volcanic sand on the island of Niuafo'ou and lets the heat hatch them.
tonga.ask: Which country's island of Niuafo'ou is home to the malau, a bird that lets warm volcanic sand hatch its eggs?

kiribati.fact: The bokikokiko, a small reed warbler, lives only on Kiritimati and Washington Island in Kiribati.
kiribati.ask: Which country's Kiritimati island is the only home of a small warbler called the bokikokiko?

nauru.fact: The Nauru reed warbler is the only songbird on Nauru and lives nowhere else.
nauru.ask: Which tiny island country's only songbird is a reed warbler found nowhere else?

marshall-islands.fact: In 2011 the Marshall Islands made nearly 2 million square km of its ocean a shark sanctuary, the largest in the world at the time.
marshall-islands.ask: Which country made nearly 2 million square km of ocean a shark sanctuary in 2011?

micronesia.fact: Reef manta rays live around the island of Yap in Micronesia all year, and many gather in Mi'l Channel.
micronesia.ask: Which country's island of Yap has manta rays living around it all year round?

palau.fact: Millions of golden jellyfish swim across Jellyfish Lake in Palau every day.
palau.ask: Which country's Jellyfish Lake sees millions of golden jellyfish swim across it every day?

south-pole.fact: South polar skuas, tough brown seabirds, have been seen at the geographic South Pole itself, far from any sea.
south-pole.ask: Which spot in the middle of the ice, far from any sea, has had visits from south polar skuas?

ross-ice-shelf.fact: In 2015 scientists drilled through about 740 meters of the Ross Ice Shelf and filmed fish swimming in the dark water far beneath it.
ross-ice-shelf.ask: Through which great sheet of floating ice did scientists drill in 2015 to find fish living in the dark below?

antarctic-peninsula.fact: Gentoo penguins nest right around the old British base at Port Lockroy, a museum and post office off the Antarctic Peninsula.
antarctic-peninsula.ask: Off which part of Antarctica do gentoo penguins nest around Port Lockroy's penguin post office?

deception-island.fact: Baily Head on Deception Island has a huge colony of chinstrap penguins, counted at about 100,000 pairs.
deception-island.ask: Which Antarctic island's Baily Head has a huge colony of chinstrap penguins?

weddell-sea.fact: In 2021 scientists found a giant icefish breeding colony on the floor of the Weddell Sea, with about 60 million fish covering some 240 square km.
weddell-sea.ask: In which Antarctic sea did scientists find a giant icefish breeding colony of about 60 million fish in 2021?

cape-denison.fact: In 2010 a giant iceberg got stuck near Cape Denison, making it much harder for the cape's Adélie penguins to reach the sea.
cape-denison.ask: Which windy Antarctic cape had its Adélie penguins blocked from the sea by a stuck iceberg in 2010?
